mgmt_bio.text: Rosa joined the company in 1996 and has since held a range of leadership positions spanning engineering, clinical and product development, and marketing. His appointment reflects Intuitive's tendency to promote from within, giving its largely tenured executive team deep institutional knowledge and cultural continuity. Under his leadership, capital allocation priorities center on reinvesting in the business, tuck-in acquisitions (largely of international distributors to move to a direct sales model) and returning excess capital to shareholders via buybacks.
